name: ModelVariant459_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant459_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the config record at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, gets three slot parts and makes four setup texture uploads (data + 0xC4, 0x8C, 0x1C and 0xE0) before setting up three webs, sixteen glows, a sheet, the globe (nine rows of seventeen points at work + 0xFF8), the nine-by-nine screen grid and five curtains, otherwise it runs one frame (sheet, spiral, screen grid, curtains and globe from the config's start, second and fade frames); a fifth upload (data + 0) happens only in later frame updates once the fade frame is reached, inside the branch that calls DrawGlobe while the phase is below 6, and only when the phase after that call is at least 5 (so it also runs on an update where DrawGlobe advances the phase from 5 to 6); it returns 4 in phases 2-4, then 1 once and 2 after the fade; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in all fourteen model-712 stage-9/10 images; the PAL header-476/626 images, including the Spanish two, build it from the same source with palette x 640. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
